lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7 distinct, high-contrast vertical white line segments are visible across the dark grey torso. The spacing is irregular, characterized by two anterior lines with moderate spacing, a central cluster of three closely grouped lines, and two posterior lines separated by wider gaps.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments exhibit vertical discontinuities, particularly the posterior-most line which terminates in the upper third of the torso, and the central-most segments which fail to intersect the ventral boundary.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate trajectory, emerging from the skull at an approximately 55-degree posterodorsal angle before curving medially and anteriorly at the terminal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 0.9 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total longitudinal length of each horn.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal mane extending along the spine; a white V-shaped chevron between the orbital regions; two white spots on the lower mandible area; and distinct ochre-colored distal limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints.
